parameters.name: DestAliyunUid
parameters.description: The UID of the destination Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: DestPrimaryVswId
parameters.description: The primary vSwitch of the destination for VPC NAT.

parameters.name: DestRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the destination role.

parameters.name: DestSecondaryVswId
parameters.description: The secondary vSwitch of the destination for VPC NAT.

parameters.name: DestVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination VPC.

parameters.name: DestinationRegion
parameters.description:
The region ID of the destination instance. For details, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

> -  If the destination instance is a self-managed database with a public IP address or a third-party ApsaraDB database, you can set this parameter to **ap-southeast-1** or the area ID that is geographically closest to the database.
-  This parameter is required when the DTS task is a data migration or data synchronization task.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region ID of the source instance. For details, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
> If the source instance is a self-managed database with a public IP address or a third-party ApsaraDB database, you can set this parameter to **ap-southeast-1** or the area ID that is geographically closest to the database.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region to which the DTS instance belongs. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SrcAliyunUid
parameters.description: The UID of the source Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: SrcPrimaryVswId
parameters.description: The primary vSwitch of the source for VPC NAT.

parameters.name: SrcRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the source role.

parameters.name: SrcSecondaryVswId
parameters.description: The secondary vSwitch of the source for VPC NAT.

parameters.name: SrcVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the source VPC.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The connection method of the self-managed database or third-party ApsaraDB database. Valid values:
- **internet**: connected over the Internet.
- **vpc**: connected over Express Connect, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
- **true**: The node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node.
- **false**: The node is not a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node.
